5c4ff737523066bf4f97e1a19613189aa290a25b.summary: Malwarebytes reports Magecart-linked credit card skimmers hosted on Heroku, a container-based platform-as-a-service owned by Salesforce. The skimmers are injected into compromised shopping sites, overlay a fake payment iframe, and send stolen card data back in encoded form. The report says the abusive instances were reported to Heroku and taken down.

5c7412f41750686d04fcdc582d97efff5b043a5b.summary: AhnLab's ASEC analysis team reports that the RedEyes group (also known as APT37 and ScarCruft) distributed malware in Korea by exploiting the old HWP EPS flaw CVE-2017-8291 in a Hangul document. A shellcode step extracted a payload hidden inside a JPEG image, which then installed a new backdoor named M2RAT. M2RAT takes commands through shared memory and sends keystrokes, documents and screenshots to its server. The report says the group targets individuals such as human rights activists, reporters and North Korean defectors, and that its aim appears to be exfiltration.

5c02cbcfd2c9ad05d4034cde8fbad0e30a6b48e2.summary: Threatray Labs reports a new variant of the GZipLoader, the loader component of the IcedID banking Trojan. The variant was first seen in its feeds on February 9, 2022. It adds dynamic resolution of Windows API functions and string encryption, and removes the SSL-pinning feature. The report says the changed control flow could break pattern-based detection rules such as YARA rules, and recommends rechecking detections for IcedID.

5ca65a6165a66309151b15bfc4e53038c83e96f2.summary: This is Kubernetes product documentation about Jobs, a workload object that runs one or more pods to completion.
